integrity: The all-budget exact uniqueness proof uses conditional Gaussian bridge variances, convexity and geometric-series stationarity; 405 exact rational supplementary assertions were independently executable inside the package, not used as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Standard pinned Brownian bridge, finite nonadaptive exact sampling, independent identically distributed known delivery indicators, integrated posterior mean-square path loss only; no additive noise, correlated missingness, adaptive designs, other kernels or historical priority certification.
title: Exact optimal sampling for Brownian-bridge path reconstruction with independent observation erasures
